privacy.thirdParties: Open-Meteo (weather for green speed), OpenStreetMap and Esri (maps). Only the course location is sent.

plist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Tap-In uses the camera and LiDAR scanner to scan putting greens, film putts (Putt Cam) and read course QR codes.
plist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Tap-In uses your location to find the golf course and green you're on.
plist.NSMotionUsageDescription: Tap-In uses motion sensors for the level check, Stroke Meter and Putt Cam horizon.
